entries.description: Free client-side browser 3D model viewer for inspecting STL, OBJ, and 3MF files at exact 1:1 real-world physical scale using monitor PPI or credit card calibration, wireframe overlay, and mobile AR export.
representativeQueries: how to view a 3D STL model at 1:1 real-world size in the browser
check true physical dimensions of an OBJ or 3MF file on screen
calibrate monitor PPI with a credit card to preview a 3D print 1:1
preview an STL file in mobile AR without uploading files to a server
